q.x: If this topic interests you, check out the really awesome lecture by one of the original paper authors. It's both informative and very well done. [link]

desc: Recent evidence suggests that a massive body is lurking at the outskirts of our solar system, far beyond the orbits of the known giant planets. This object, at a distance approximately 20 times further than Neptune and with a mass approximately 5000 times larger than Pluto, is the real ninth planet of the solar system.
